name: current_conditions
description: Latest instantaneous (real-time) readings for one or more USGS gauge sites. Returns the most recent value per site × parameter — e.g. current streamflow and gage height for a river. Common parameter codes: 00060 = discharge/streamflow (ft³/s), 00065 = gage height (ft), 00010 = water temperature (°C), 00045 = precipitation (in), 00095 = specific conductance, 00300 = dissolved oxygen, 63680 = turbidity. Keyless.

sites.description: Comma-separated USGS site numbers, e.g. "01646500" (Potomac at Washington DC) or "01646500,01647000".

parameter_codes.description: Comma-separated USGS parameter codes (default "00060,00065" = streamflow + gage height).

name: daily_values
description: Daily-values time series for a single USGS site + parameter over a date range. Returns one statistic per day (default mean). Useful for trends, hydrographs, and historical comparison. Common statCd: 00003 = mean, 00001 = max, 00002 = min. Common parameter codes: 00060 = discharge (ft³/s), 00065 = gage height (ft), 00010 = water temperature (°C). Keyless.

site.description: A single USGS site number, e.g. "01646500".

stat_code.description: Daily statistic code (default "00003" = mean; 00001 = max, 00002 = min).

name: find_sites
description: Discover active USGS gauge sites in a US state that are currently reporting a given parameter (real-time). Returns sites with their latest reading; useful for finding which gauges are live in a region. Can match many sites, so results are capped. Keyless.
